# watchpoint_report_share_link (Resource)

A public, unauthenticated link to a `watchpoint_scheduled_report`'s latest render (and its PDF for SLA reports). Anyone with the URL can view it until it expires or is destroyed, which revokes it. Every change replaces the link with a new URL. Requires the public report links feature and `reports.manage`; refused when the tenant's compliance policy disallows public pages.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_report_share_link" "exec" {
  report_id       = watchpoint_scheduled_report.weekly_sla.id
  label           = "Executive summary"
  expires_in_days = 90
}

output "exec_report_url" {
  value     = watchpoint_report_share_link.exec.url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `report_id` (String) ID of the report to share.

### Optional

- `expires_in_days` (Number) Lifetime in days: `7`, `30` or `90`. Omit for a link that never expires.
- `label` (String) Label shown in the portal (120 characters max). Defaults to `Public link`.

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String) Expiry timestamp (RFC 3339), or null.
- `id` (String) Link ID.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The link token. Returned only on create; an imported link has none.
- `token_prefix` (String) First characters of the token, as the portal shows them.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) The public URL. Sensitive, since it carries the token.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_report_share_link.exec <report-id>/<link-id>
```
